user.title: Home Assistant VSCode Tunnel
user.description: This integration starts a Microsoft VS Code Remote Tunnel using GitHub authorization. Starting downloads the Microsoft CLI if needed and accepts its server license terms. The wait applies to each check, including this setup. After setup the tunnel switch is off.

wait.title: Starting tunnel
wait.description: No authentication code or tunnel URL has arrived yet. The process remains active. Submit to check again. This session stops automatically after ten minutes.
